notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only tower-specific source is a 1972 newspaper feature that lists a Prosperity Tower phone line; no source found gives a build date, design, staffing or fate. Mapcarta is an auto-generated listing (OpenStreetMap tower tag). The Forest Lookouts South Carolina index lists PROSPERITY beside a 'Newberry County - South Carolina Forestry Commission' line, but the layout is ambiguous, so no agency fact is recorded. The brief's elevation (198 m) is ground elevation and is not used. Story is about 127 words after the fact-check. Search budget used up; no further lookup. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the 1972 wording was confirmed on the page; attribution changed from 'the paper' to 'the article', and the burning and closure sentences were reworded to avoid copying the quotes.
